bluf: Tug is an independent London agency, founded 2006, with six offices from Berlin to Sydney, selling enterprise brands an AI powered mix of data, media and proprietary tools. It leads with Data & Measurement and AI Automation, and its showcase is GEO for Mitchells & Butlers, begun late 2025 across 1,700+ venues. The record points further into AI visibility, with GEO research such as a 27 August 2026 post on ChatGPT's Reddit citations. A rival should know its own house practises 1 of 4 tested lines (no Google ads, no social pixel, no LinkedIn ads) and 13 of its 20 clients are names only.
doing:
The positioning line, a global AI powered brand and performance agency blending data, media, content and proprietary technology to drive demand and incremental growth, decodes to measured media: buy across channels, then prove the increment with its own tools. The headline claim is a case, not a size: GEO plus a custom Market Share Index turned zero click search into AI and social visibility for Mitchells & Butlers.

The sold mix is broad, breadth 13, with two lead lines at score 3: AI Automation / Agents (an AI & Marketing Technology pillar builds automation, ML models and custom tools) and Data & Measurement (Real Impact causal modelling, Single Source dashboards, a Zipcar podcast incrementality case); both families score 3.45. Core at score 2: AI Search / GEO, SEO (Merlin and GenesisCare cases), Paid Search (PPC, Bing Ads, PMax), Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Reddit) and Programmatic & CTV (DV360, addressable TV, DOOH). Proprietary products: Real Impact, Single Source, Market Share Index, Landing Page Monitor (automated technical SEO checks) and Tug Labs, a page title only. No partners are listed.

AI posture: it brands itself AI powered, selling GEO through proprietary AI inclusion and advocacy tech and building AI automation, ML models and predictive analytics in house.

Moves in date order: shortlisted for Campaign's Global Performance Agency of the Year (April 2024) and at the Global Search Awards (June 2024); won the PMW Global Awards Integrated category (July 2024); appointed by Suzanne Grae in Sydney (November 2024); began Mitchells & Butlers work in late 2025. The 3 open roles, a Paid Media Account Manager, an SEO Manager and a Paid Media Account Executive, are execution seats, not AI or data hires.

Pricing: none in the record. Conspicuously absent for an enterprise AI and measurement shop: an employee count, any platform partner, Email & CRM and Web & Product lines (both 0), and case pages the deepen pass could date.
